title: Qt: Disable Sorting for the packet List
description:
Allows the sorting to be disabled to avoid painful recalculations if the
sorting has been clicked on by accident.

Fixes #16786

notes.body:
@rknall Should these match like the other preferences?  
"packet_list_is_sortable" "gui_packet_list_sortable"

```
    prefs_register_bool_preference(gui_module, "packet_list_is_sortable",
                                   "Allow packet list to be sortable",
                                   "To prevent sorting by mistake (which can take some time to calculate), it can be disabled",
                                   &prefs.gui_packet_list_sortable);
```

Update: Oops - I should have scrolled down. There are plenty that don't match. So probably best not to assume there is a naming convention to follow.
```
    register_string_like_preference(gui_module, "interfaces_hidden_types", "Hide interface types in list",

        &prefs.gui_interfaces_hide_types, PREF_STRING, NULL, TRUE);
```
